description.value:
Not every sentinel meets danger head-on. Those who walk the Path of Shadows favor patience over confrontation, melting into darkness and silence until the perfect moment to strike from an enemy's blind side.

Trained in stealth, misdirection, and the quiet application of the Force, these sentinels turn concealment itself into a weapon. A single unseen strike, delivered with precision, often accomplishes what a dozen open blows could not.
